english: Shut up!\nNot taking that from you!
Idiot! My shades\nare part of my face!\nCan't take off my face!
No work's no excuse\nto get mixed up\nin something this shady!
That's MY line.\nStill doing this\nin a place like this?
...Next! Who is it?!\nNumber six! Come out!
Shut up!\nAt least let me dream!
I'll stay a\ndreaming middle-aged man!\n...Just you wait! Damn it!!!!
Anyway, Gin,\nback to the menu screen\nand try again!
Blame the developers.\nSee ya! Stay well!
Hey! Organizers!\nWhat's going on?!\nShe's a minor!
No choice, I guess.\n...Kagura!\nI won't hold back!!
I was passing by.\nThey offered\npickled kelp, so...
Not really keen,\nbut I ate the kelp.\nCan't eat and run.
For pickled kelp,\nI'll beat even you, Gin!
Thought you'd say that...\nSix down!\nWho's the last one?!
Damn! Never thought\nKagura was this strong!
Why are you here?\nAnd why are YOU champion?!
What a selfish bastard!\nWe'll settle this\nright here!
Still being champion\nin a place like this?!
You just don't think!\nAlways going with the flow!\nEnough! Let's go!
Hmm... Lately,\nit's really grown on me.\n...Fate's a funny thing.
Don't need a\nmeaningless title.\nJust give me the prize.
Huh... Well, thanks.\nI'll use it\nif I get the chance.\f...See ya.
Congratulaaations!!\nWell done, Yorozuya Gin!\nA new champion is born!!

No sense of occasion...
Read the room!
...Fine. Here's the prize! Only the hero who
beats seven opponents
gets this ultimate Gin Tama!!
Don't giggle!\nYou were the enemy\na minute ago!
Forget the past.\n...More importantly,\nbuy me pickled kelp!
Damn! Losing the prize\nis one thing. Losing\nto Zura is worse!
...Don't hate me.\nIt seems to be Game Over.
Tch! Forget the title.\nGive me the prize already!
Let's get this over with!\nCome out!\nYou cheating late entrant!
I'd love to...\fBut could you wait\njust a bit longer\nfor that ultimate Gin Tama?
Hmm? Talk like that...\nYou're afraid\nyou can't beat him, huh?
...Shall we begin?\nOr... Did seeing\nmy face scare you?
...Enough talk.\nFight me?\nOr run with your tail tucked?
No skills to spare\nfor your selfish ideals!\n...Don't WANT them, either!
Wait, Takasugi!\nNot letting you leave like this!
Next time we meet...\nYou'll pay for this.
...Well, thanks.\nI'll use it\nif I get the chance.\f...See ya.
Congratulaaations!!\nWell done, Yorozuya Gin!\nNOW a new champion is born!!
Wait!\nNot letting you leave!\fToday, we're\nsettling this!
Full of spirit.\n...But I can't\noblige you.
Blame this rotten world\nand your own spineless self.
Never mind that...\nGood timing!\nCould you help me?
Well, in for a penny...\nFine. I'll help.
No worry there.\nI know where\nhe'd probably go.\fCome with me?
In exchange...\nFind him, and treat me\na little better, okay...?
Finding runaway manga artists\nis an editor's job.\nNothing to do with me.
Tch! Thought I could\nearn a favor\nand get better treatment...!
Honestly! He's not here.\nLet's get going!
He just wanted\nto come play here!
Here! Here!\nSuspicious!\nEven more than the last place!
Not THAT often...\nOnly about\nseven days a week...
Let's go!\nOne more weird place\nand I punch you. With a fist.
No, he hasn't been here...\n...Oh! Onishi!
He often comes\nto nap in broad daylight.\n...Here for a nap today too?
But the waitresses\nare all so pretty.
Tch! No choice.\nLet's go somewhere\nhe might REALLY be...
Not very reliable...\nWell, this place\nisn't especially shady...
Excuse me.\nHas the manga artist\nSorachi been here?
Damn! Wasted our time\nand effort! That's it!\nI'm quitting this manga!!
Whenever he's stuck\non work,\nhe climbs this tree.
Hiding in a tree?!\nAre you a monkey?!
If you knew,\nwhy didn't we\ncome here first?!
Or... Is this\nShenron?\nA Dragon Ball thing?
What?!\fThen is this dragon\nthe god of Dragon Tama?!
I see... Bring\nall seven Dragon Tama\nhere, then.
Right!\fWait here! I'll get\nall the Dragon Tama\nand bring them here!
Um... Unless\nmy eyes are playing tricks...\n...A dragon, right? Probably...

...Name aside,
it's definitely
linked to Dragon Tama... Gin... Maybe this dragon
grants wishes...?
No idea\nif it's a god, though...
I SAID!\nObviously a dragon\nwill come out!
Maybe we woke up\nsomething we\nshouldn't have...
L-looks that way to me too.\f...Well, it IS\na dragon, I suppose...
Whoa!\fY-you'll really\ngrant a wish?\fW-wait a second!\nUm, um...
Well...\nI'll tell you later.\fLet's go,\nShinpachi! Kagura!
